info.title: Packio API
info.description: Stateless JSON API for Packio automation.

scopes.description: Requested scopes: `read`, `write`, `admin`, `*`, or `<family>:<read|write|*>` where family is members, organizations, packages, releases, sources, tokens or webhooks. The admin scope is only granted to users with the admin role.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration date in RFC3339 format.

plain_token.description: Plain token value. It is returned once and is never stored in plaintext.

204.description: Organization deleted or scheduled for deletion

503.description: Package deletion is temporarily unavailable; retry the request

get.description: Returns 20 users by default, at most 100 per page. Search matches case-insensitive substrings in email or display name; wildcard characters are literal. Results use PostgreSQL database-collation email ascending, then UUID ascending order. Clients must traverse pages to enumerate users.
